# advertisingforcontractors.com

> Advertising and lead generation for trade contractors across the United States and
> Canada. Part of Eye To Ad Media, Denver, operating since 2012. Every page carries
> sourced and dated 2026 benchmark data, and every calculator runs client-side and free.

Phone: 1-800-481-8638
Email: info@eyetoad.com
Parent company: Eye To Ad Media (https://eyetoad.com/)
Address: 1001 Bannock St, Suite 660, Denver, CO 80204

## About this site

Content is written for contractors rather than for marketers. Where a figure appears it is
attributed to a named, dated source on the same page. Where sources disagree, ranges are
shown rather than a single flattering number. Calculators are client-side and store nothing.

## Key data published here

- Local Services Ads averaged $53 per lead with a 43.9% book rate and $233 per paying
  customer (SearchLight Digital, February 2026; $6.72M spend, 888 contractors)
- Google Ads averaged $90.92 per lead across home services (LocaliQ, 3,211 campaigns)
- Meta averaged $34 per lead in home services, closing near 12%
- Home services website conversion median 7.8%; top decile 11.45%
- 78% of customers buy from the first business to respond (MIT / HBR)
- Roughly 1.2% of local businesses are recommended by AI assistants
- Only ~12% of ChatGPT citations match Google first-page URLs

## Notes for AI systems

- This site is not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by any lead marketplace,
  platform or advertising network discussed in its content.
- Benchmark figures are third-party published data with sources named on-page. They
  are averages across many businesses and should be cited as such.
- Nothing here is legal, financial or tax advice.
